data.current_description: Outright (futures) markets: a field of participants priced for one winner question, such as a race or golf tournament winner, or a season future (Super Bowl, NFL/NCAAF/CFL outright/conference/division, NBA Championship, Stanley Cup, World Series, AFL and AFL Women Grand Final, Rugby World Cup, NRL, plus MVP, regular season awards, Heisman, winning conference, Brownlow, team perfect/winless record, team undefeated, final exact forecast, and each top soccer league's winner, top goalscorer and relegation). The per-team grids are also served: to make the playoffs (a Yes/No selection per team) and regular season wins (an Over/Under selection per team, carrying the team's line) -- each cell is a selection with side and, for over/under, line. Separate from /odds, which has head-to-head match odds. Prices update every few minutes. When futures are not available for a sport the response is {"enabled": false}.
data.summary_suggestion: Retrieve outright and futures markets with field selections
data.description_suggestion: Retrieves bet365 outright (futures) markets including championship winners, season futures, team-specific grids (playoff qualification, regular season wins), and award markets across all supported sports. Returns OutrightEvent objects with OutrightMarket and OutrightSelection data, including each-way terms where offered. Prices update every few minutes. When futures are unavailable for a sport, returns {"enabled": false}. Optional sport parameter filters by sport (default: soccer); use sport=all for all sports.

data.current_summary: Results / settlement (finished matches, final & period scores)
data.current_description: Finished matches with the final score, per-period scores where available (halves for soccer, sets for tennis, table tennis, volleyball and badminton, quarters for basketball and American football, periods for ice hockey, innings for baseball), a status and the time the match finished. status is finished when the match reached full time (a player or side won the required sets, or baseball reached the 9th inning), and unknown when it stopped before that, usually because it was abandoned, suspended or postponed, or a tennis retirement (which bet365 does not expose); the last score is still returned. An overtime flag and a note are added when the match was decided beyond regulation, and cricket carries its run result and score format (wickets/runs per innings) in the note.
data.description_suggestion: Retrieves finished matches with final scores, per-period breakdowns (halves for soccer, sets for tennis/table tennis/volleyball/badminton, quarters for basketball/American football, periods for ice hockey, innings for baseball), match status, and completion time. Returns MatchResult objects with status field: 'finished' for matches reaching full time, 'unknown' for abandoned/suspended/postponed matches or tennis retirements. Includes overtime flag and descriptive note for matches decided beyond regulation. Cricket results include run totals and score format (wickets/runs per innings). Optional parameters: sport (default: soccer), fixture_id, and group_id for filtering. Prices and results update in real-time.

data.current_description: Recorded price points for a match, oldest first. Each point carries the same selection-identity fields as /odds (group_id, group_name, market_id, sel_id, label, and side/line/handicap/n2 where the market uses them), so a point maps to a team/side/line without re-fetching /odds. Narrow with group, sel and a from/to window; results are capped at limit rows (default 5000, max 50000; the newest within the window are kept). odds_frac is derived from odds_dec, which is authoritative. A match with separate pre-match and live ids is returned whole: pass either id; fixture_ids lists the ids included. A busy or timed-out archive read answers 503 with a Retry-After header. Rate limit: 120 requests per minute per IP.

data.current_description: Per selection, the pre-match close (pre_close: the last price recorded at or before kickoff) and the last recorded price (last). Each selection row and its pre_close/last points carry the same selection-identity fields as /odds (group_name, and side/line/handicap/n2 where the market uses them), so a row maps to a team/side/line without a /odds round-trip. A match with separate pre-match and live ids is returned whole: pass either id; fixture_ids lists the ids included and prematch_id names the pre-match one. pre_close_basis says how the close was found (kickoff, prematch-records or omitted); kickoff_estimated is true when the kickoff is an estimate, and an estimate is never used to pick the close. closed is false while the match is upcoming (pre_close is provisional) and true once it has kicked off, gone in play, or finished. A busy or timed-out archive read answers 503 with a Retry-After header. Rate limit: 120 requests per minute per IP.
